plugins/jeeglowbe/desktop/php/jeeglowbe..jeeGlow lit les équipements visibles et: jeeGlow reads the visible and enabled devices of your objects. Check that at least one device is visible, or widen your search.

plugins/jeeglowbe/desktop/js/jeeglowbe.j.Trop d'équipements pour un seul dashboar: Too many devices for a single dashboard: the list is truncated.

plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Nom affiché en haut du dashboard. Vide,: Name shown at the top of the dashboard. Empty means "jeeGlow".
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Les équipements qui n'appartiennent à au: Devices that belong to no object are grouped in an "Unassigned" room. Hiding them gives a cleaner dashboard, but makes it easy to forget they exist.
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Une pièce sans aucun équipement visible: A room without any visible device does not appear. Untick to see your whole object tree, including floors that only exist to organise it.
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Minutes d'inactivité au bout desquelles: Minutes of inactivity after which a tablet returns to the home view. 0 never returns. Only applies in kiosk mode.
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Pourcentage d'assombrissement de l'écran: How much the screen is darkened at night, from 0 to 70 per cent. Night hours are the ones you gave Jeedom to switch themes.
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Retire des noms affichés les identifiant: Removes hardware identifiers and whatever precedes a dash from displayed names: "OpenMQTTGateway 1629AC — OMG_ESP32_BLE_SALON" becomes "OMG_ESP32_BLE_SALON". Affects the display in jeeGlow only, never the name in Jeedom, and a hand-given name always wins.
